name: submit_extraction
description: Submit all extracted paragraphs from this page of the German legal document. Must be called exactly once per page.

paragraphs.description: All paragraphs on this page, in reading order from top to bottom.

page.description: 1-based page index. Copy verbatim from the page number stated in the user message; do not infer from the image.

paragraph.description: 1-based paragraph index within this page, starting at 1 and incrementing by 1 in reading order.

text.description:
Markdown-formatted paragraph text. Use **bold**, *italic*, underline. Preserve German orthography (ä ö ü ß) and legal abbreviations (§, Rn., Abs., BGB, ArbGG, ZPO, Az.) verbatim. Internal line breaks as \n. Tables as GitHub-flavored markdown with
for in-cell line breaks. Use [unleserlich] for illegible text. Prefix stamps/handwriting/signatures with [Stempel]:, [Handschrift]:, [Unterschrift]:.
